result.topic_en: Calculations with theta-type series P, R (and p, q, r) for the lemniscatic functions: factoring an expression LL, expressing a numerator as ppqqrr, a quotient R/P as series, and derivative relations PP'' - P'P' in terms of P*, R*.
result.transcription:
So ist
$LL = (a,0)^2\{(a,0)^2 PPRR - \tfrac12(a,\tfrac12)^2(P^4+R^4)\} - \tfrac12(a,\tfrac12)^2\{(a,0)^2(P^4+R^4) - 2(a,\tfrac12)^2 PPRR\}$
oder $a,0 = A$
$a,\tfrac12 = B$ gesetzt
$2LL = 2A^4PPRR - 2AABB(P^4+R^4) + 2B^4PPRR$
[-und-]
$LL = (AAPP - BBRR)(AARR - BBPP)$

Der Zähler ist nichts anderes als $ppqqrr$
also $B = pprr = \tfrac14(*r)^4$
$= \tfrac14(\mu^{\frac12} + \mu^{\frac92} + \mu^{\frac{25}{2}} + )^4$

$\frac{R}{P} = \frac{\frac{xx}{1-x^4}(y+\frac1y) - \frac{x^6}{1-x^{12}}(y^3+\frac1{y^3}) + \frac{x^{10}}{1-x^{20}}(y^5+\frac1{y^5}) - }{\frac{1}{x(x+x^9+x^{25}..)(1+2x^4+2x^{16}+)}}$
# Hier wird
$A = \frac{-8\mu^4 + 32\mu^{16} - 72\mu^{36} +}{1 - 2\mu^4 + 2\mu^{16} - 2\mu^{36} +} = \frac{q'}{q}$
$B = \frac{(1+2\mu^8+2\mu^{32}+2\mu^{72}+..)(4\mu\mu + 36\mu^{18} + 100\mu^{50} +) - (16\mu^8 + 64\mu^{32} + 144\mu^{72})(2\mu\mu + 2\mu^{18} + 2\mu^{50} + 2\mu^{98}...)}{qq}$
Zähler von $B = 4\mu\mu - 24\mu^{10} + 36\mu^{18} + 40\mu^{26}$
Es ist nemlich $PP'' - P'P' = \pi'\{1 + \mu^8(x^4+x^{-4}) + \mu^{32}(x^8+x^{-8}) + \mu^{72}(x^{12}+x^{-12}) ..$
$+ \rho'\{\mu\mu(x^2+x^{-2}) + \mu^{18}(x^6+x^{-6}) + \mu^{50}(x^{10}+x^{-10}) ..$
$= \pi' P^* + \rho' R^*$
während
$PP = \pi P^* + \rho R^*$ wo $\pi, \rho$ die Werthe von $P^*, R^*$ für $x=1$
$RR = \rho P^* + \pi R^*$ und $\pi', \rho'$ die derivirten Grössen sind
$\pi' = \frac{\mu d\pi}{d\mu}$, $\rho' = \frac{\mu d\rho}{d\rho}$[?]
